entities.name: David Freeman-Mitford, 2nd Baron Redesdale

entities.summary: David Bertram Ogilvy Freeman-Mitford, 2nd Baron Redesdale, was a British peer, soldier, and landowner. He was the father of the Mitford sisters, in whose various novels and memoirs he is depicted.
